argv:
[Console]::OutputEncoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$usb = @(Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.InstanceId -like 'USB\*'} | ForEach-Object { $c=Get-PnpDeviceProperty -InstanceId $_.InstanceId -KeyName 'DEVPKEY_Device_ProblemCode' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [PSCustomObject]@{Status=$_.Status;ProblemCode=$c.Data;Name=$_.FriendlyName;InstanceId=$_.InstanceId}})
$ips = @(Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.AddressState -eq 'Preferred'} | Select-Object InterfaceAlias,IPAddress,PrefixLength)
$neighbors = @(Get-NetNeighbor -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.IPAddress -like '10.139.153.*'} | Select-Object InterfaceAlias,IPAddress,State)
[PSCustomObject]@{USB=$usb;HostIPv4=$ips;KnownSubnetNeighbors=$neighbors} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
